newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco fuel oil down in March.
newsitem.headline: Morocco fuel oil down in March.

text.p: Morocco's monthly fuel oil price has been set at 1,840.82 dirhams ($197) per tonne in March, down 77.78 dirhams, Morocco's energy ministry said on Friday.
"The price change was attributed to a fall of oil prices on the international market in February," it added in a statement.
Gas oil and kerosene fell respectively 10 and 21 cents to 5.07 dirhams and 3.51 dirhams a litre, the ministry said.
Pump prices for super and ordinary petrol remained unchanged at 7.65 and 7.42 dirhams a litre respectively.
